### Broken Cisterns
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-february-4-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 2:13
Points:
- Believers frequently turn to earthly security, status, and human relationships to find fulfillment.
- Like ancient Israel, people foolishly exchange an all-powerful God for powerless worldly idols.
- Earthly pursuits are broken cisterns completely incapable of satisfying our inner spiritual thirst.
- Confessing our reliance on worldly substitutes directs us back to Jesus, the true living water.

### The Long Road of Obedience
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/the-long-road-of-obedience-one-year-devotions-for-women-may-31.html
Passage: Jeremiah 2:13
Points:
- Disobedience and idolatry leave believers drinking foul, bitter water rather than pure refreshment.
- Preferring cracked cisterns starts when personal desires take priority over God's word.
- Turning away from God must be recognized and addressed as sin rather than a minor flaw.
- Committing to the road of obedience restores our connection to the fountain of living water.

### Bible Pathways - Aug. 14, 2008
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-aug-14-2008-11580455.html
Passage: Jeremiah 2:11-13
Points:
- God is the only true fountain able to supply lasting emotional and spiritual satisfaction.
- Abandoning God in pursuit of self-sufficient living reflects tragic ingratitude and foolishness.
- Human writings and worldly wisdom can never substitute for the life-giving truth of Scripture.
- Believers must stand firm in God's truth even when surrounded by a culture of compromise.
